en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph showing a docked sailing ship with three masts along a waterside. In the background, there are multi-story stone buildings with traditional European architecture. One building has signage reading 'A.-B. JOH. PERSSON'S KAFFEROSTERI,' suggesting a coffee roastery business. The reverse side contains handwritten text and an address to 'Fröken Olivia Persson' in 'Svartvik, Sundsvall.' The handwriting and format are reminiscent of early 20th-century correspondence.
